title: WaterColor "Believing For" 47 Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- 3 adult bikes provided- Gas Grill - Wine Cooler - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Surrounded by mature trees in the Forest District of WaterColor, Believing For is a charming 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home that sleeps up to 10 guests. Delight in a tranquil setting with access to WaterColor’s numerous amenities—including a private beach club and multiple community pools! With well-appointed furnishings and ample space throughout, this home will transform every stay into a relaxing retreat.A wide front porch welcomes guests arriving at this 2-story bungalow. The spacious combined living, dining, and kitchen areas exude relaxed, coastal luxury. Elegant furniture, consisting of a soft sleeper sofa, loveseat, and armchairs, forms an intimate seating area around the 47” TV. In the kitchen, high-end appliances and granite countertops make cooking a joyful experience. Thanks to the open floor plan and seating for 4 at the breakfast bar, the family chef can easily chat with friends and family—or share a bottle of wine chilled in the cooler—while dinner simmers in the background. A large dining room table with 2 chairs and 2 long benches adds the final touch to the room. At the back of the home, a covered porch with a 4-person table and bench swing overlooks the beautiful wooded landscape. When it’s time to retire, there is a primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom on this floor.Upstairs, guests will find 2 additional bedrooms—each with queen beds and private bathrooms. A daybed with a trundle bed tucked into a cozy alcove in the hall offers extra sleeping accommodations or a relaxing reading spot.Indulge in a quiet, luxurious WaterColor stay at Believing For. Guests can park up to 2 vehicles in the driveway and leisurely explore the area on the 3 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, choose between the private beach club in main WaterColor or the nearby public beaches of Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara. Book this lovely beach home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubLiving Room: Queen Sleeper SECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Landing Area: Twin Daybed with Twin Trundle *Unfortunately, this home does not allow pets at any time.*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
